extraction.name: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) is a comprehensive benchmark for text embeddings that spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.inLanguage: ara, cmn, deu, eng, fra, ita, pol, rus, spa, tur
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Dataset created for MTEB using available data from Reddit posts.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The authors note that controlling for data contamination between the benchmark datasets and the models' pre-training datasets is challenging, which may affect evaluation scores.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for evaluating and benchmarking text embedding models across 8 diverse tasks (Bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization) to assess their universal applicability.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The benchmark is open-source, hosted on GitHub and the Hugging Face Hub, and utilizes versioning at both the dataset and software levels for reproducibility. The maintainers plan to continue development by welcoming community contributions via pull requests.

name.evidence: we introduce the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB).

description.evidence: MTEB spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages. Through the benchmarking of 33 models on MTEB, we establish the most comprehensive benchmark of text embeddings to date.

url.evidence: MTEB comes with open-source code and a public leaderboard at https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/mteb

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Our scale of experiments and that of model pre-training make controlling for data contamination challenging. Thus, we ignore overlap of MTEB datasets with model training datasets in MTEB scores.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) aims to provide clarity on how models perform on a variety of embedding tasks and thus serves as the gateway to finding universal text embeddings applicable to a variety of tasks.

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.evidence: Through versioning at a dataset and software level, we aim to make it easy to reproduce results in MTEB. [...] We welcome dataset, task or metric contributions from the community via pull requests to continue the development of MTEB.
